newsitem.title: USA: Mid-American and USA Waste amend agreement.
newsitem.headline: Mid-American and USA Waste amend agreement.

text.p: Mid-American Waste Systems Inc and USA Waste Services Inc said Thursday they amended their previously announced agreement to increase the consideration paid by USA Waste to buy Mid-American.

Mid-American said the amended agreement raises the price from $180 million in cash and USA Waste common stock, including the assumption of about $49 million in debt, and the assumption by USA Waste of certain agreed liabilities, to $201 million in cash including the assumption of the same liabiltiies.
The transaction is subject to bankruptcy court approval. A hearing has been scheduled for March 7.
